subs.text: It's 2:47 in the morning, in Bengaluru.
Arjun is awake again.
Not because of work... because of his phone.
But that yield came with a second job.
Dashboards before stand-up. Risk updates at lunch. Transactions at midnight.
And the one night he didn't check... a pool he was in turned risky.
By morning, he'd lost a chunk of it.
Bots and AI agents? Every one of them wanted his keys.
And if the AI got it wrong at 3 AM... who would stop it?
That's exactly what KRIYA does.
No more programming transactions. Arjun programs an objective.
Maximise yield.
Risk, never above forty.
Forty percent max in one place.
A quarter always in reserve.
Enforced by a smart contract on Monad. Not a promise.
Then, one night, it happened again.
Strategy B's risk jumped from thirty-four to forty-eight.
This time, Arjun was fast asleep.
Chainlink CRE caught it, and verified it onchain.
KRIYA worked out where the money should go, and the policy engine checked it.
And in about five seconds, on Monad... his money was out of B, and safe.
Without KRIYA, that money would have sat at risk until Arjun woke up.
Over four hours.
With KRIYA... five seconds.
Four hundred dollars, moved to safety, while he slept.
And when an AI proposal tried to cross the line, the contract simply said no.
AI proposes. Contracts enforce.
KRIYA.
Your capital, on autopilot. Within your rules.
Built solo by Saurabh Nage... live now, on Monad testnet.
